pages.title: Manifestations Of Jin

detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text:
1) Speak to Master Tallon Darkfist in Tanvu. You must collect a few manifestations.
2) Turn so the water if on your left and the land is on your right, and start running along the coast. You will almost immediately run into the second manifestation, Liquid Essence of Jin, that wanders along the coastline. (-4478, -73853, +227)
3) Keep running in the same direction and you will run into a gazebo like structure. In the middle of the gazebo is the first manifestation. (-8876, -76338, +1449).
4) Head directly north-northeast and about 2/3 of the way up the hill in a very small building, you'll find the fourth manifestation. (-935, -91864, +1861).
5) Head west-northwest and over the far side you will find a circular group of pylons. In the middle of there is the third manifestation. (-25671, -86395, +2489)
6) Return to Master Tallon Darkfist in Tanvu for your reward.

Manifestations Of Jin

Level 6 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

Objectives

Absorb the Four Manifestations

Description

1) Speak to Master Tallon Darkfist in Tanvu. You must collect a few manifestations. 2) Turn so the water if on your left and the land is on your right, and start running along the coast. You will almost immediately run into the second manifestation, Liquid Essence of Jin, that wanders along the coastline. (-4478, -73853, +227) 3) Keep running in the same direction and you will run into a gazebo like structure. In the middle of the gazebo is the first manifestation. (-8876, -76338, +1449). 4) Head directly north-northeast and about 2/3 of the way up the hill in a very small building, you'll find the fourth manifestation. (-935, -91864, +1861). 5) Head west-northwest and over the far side you will find a circular group of pylons. In the middle of there is the third manifestation. (-25671, -86395, +2489) 6) Return to Master Tallon Darkfist in Tanvu for your reward.

Notes

Master Tallon Darkfist roams near the beach. You have to hail the essence to advance the quest. This does not need to be in exact order. findings.observation: Manifestations Of Jin displays level 6, Adventuring, Tanvu, Kojan, Master Tallon Darkfist as starter and hand-in, Previous The Unforgotten part 2 and Next A Jin Divided. Five recorded disagreements concern coins (fandom) and level (fandom, wiki.silkyvenom.com:80, photographed in game Steam community screenshot, the Forgotten Horde wiki). Alternative values are absent here and remain unresolved.

Its primary objective says Absorb the Four Manifestations. The fandom-attributed account separately lists First, Second, Third and Fourth Manifestations plus Hollow Faded Crystal (1). This item count remains an attributed observation, not a verified operative requirement or canonical item identity.

Description provides an ordered coastal route and numbered manifestation coordinates. Notes names Flowing, Liquid, Forest and Fiery Essences with different coordinate observations, says to hail the essence, and says exact order is unnecessary. Preserve these separate contexts and the claim of unordered interaction without implementing a quest script or inferring canonical entity IDs.

Manifestations Location gives -996, -78619, 191 in Tanvu (-19, 6); the map separately gives Starts spot 10 House of Tallon at -2940, -80454. Notes says Master Tallon roams near the beach. These contexts do not resolve an exact spawn.

Training is Wisdom prints Find TRAINERNAME nearby, up the hill and Learn abilities from TRAINERNAME. The unresolved template text is retained verbatim and cannot identify a trainer, ability, class or learning condition. It displays level 6, starter Master Tallon Darkfist, Series Shang Village and Previous The Unforgotten - Part 2; no hand-in or Next field is displayed.

Manifestations displays Coin reward 50 c while Training is Wisdom displays unitless 50. Preserve each literal separately: the latter cannot inherit a denomination from the former. Neither cached article displays Repeatable; absence does not establish repeatability.

Part 2 lists Manifestations Of Jin and Training is Wisdom as Next. Their Previous labels provide source-specific navigation, not enforced prerequisites. Manifestations links a vgoemulator MMODB archive and Training links fandom. This review extracts cached vgsoharchive transcriptions; cited originals were not fetched or independently verified. Telonica mirrors do not provide independent corroboration.
